capture_boundary: Actual complete native UTF16 separator predicate and backward/forward scans of an A-unit-B stencil are exhaustively queried for all 65536 raw UTF16 units, including surrogate units. Stencil ranges store first/end unit and actual previous-at-3/next-at-0 outputs. Complete backward/forward context scans and directional iterator constructor execute on supplied valid UTF16 paragraph views and every nonempty scalar-aligned selected subrange. Output context/selected endpoints are read from native iterator storage. The actual bounded caller TextView window 0x96f94..0x96fd8 consumes those endpoints; source pointer/length and local selected range are read from its emitted view. Source pointer, length, selected endpoints and direction are inputs. Full measureParagraph, cache lookup, LayoutPiece and HB are not executed; paragraph slicing is established separately by disassembly.
